Bihar Alcohol Ban: bihar men sharabbandi kanun ko lekar siyasi ghamasan tej hai... aarjedi vidhayak bhaee virendr ne sharabbandi ko puri tarah phel batate hue kaha ki lalu yadav ne bhi ise lagu karne se mana kiya tha... kangres ne sharab ki jagah sukhe nashe ke barhte chalan par saval uthae... vahin, jediyu aur bijepi ne vipaksh ke aaropon ko kharij karte hue sharabbandi ko saphal bataya hai...
